children: Activ Pine LLP, an affiliate of private equity firm True North, has offloaded more than Rs 638 crore worth of shares in Bengaluru-based biopharmaceutical company Biocon through open-market transactions on September 9.
Following the block deals, Biocon shares ended at Rs 395, up 0.62 percent, amid high trading volumes on the BSE.

Activ Pine LLP sold 1.65 crore equity shares, representing a 1.02 percent stake in Biocon, at Rs 385 per share. The sale was made from its total holding of 1.08 percent, or 1.76 crore equity shares, as of June 2026.

The shares, valued at Rs 638.37 crore, were bought by 12 global and domestic marquee investors, including Citigroup, Kotak Mahindra AMC, ICICI Prudential AMC, BNP Paribas, Societe Generale and SBI Mutual Fund, at Rs 385 apiece.

ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund emerged as the largest buyer, acquiring additional 74.03 lakh shares for Rs 285.02 crore. It was followed by SBI Mutual Fund, which picked up 14.23 lakh shares for Rs 54.82 crore.

Further, Kotak Mahindra AMC and Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC each bought 12.77 lakh shares for Rs 49.16 crore. Other investors, including BNP Paribas Arbitrage, Citigroup Global Markets Singapore, WhiteOak Capital MF, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company, Bajaj Life Insurance, Societe Generale, Edelweiss Mutual Fund and Norges Bank, on behalf of the Government Pension Fund Global, each purchased 6.5 lakh shares for Rs 25.02 crore.

Among the above-mentioned investors, HDFC Life Insurance Company held a 1.01 percent stake in Biocon, while ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, through ISIF Equity Ex-Top 100 Long-Short Fund, held a 1.46 percent stake and Kotak Mahindra AMC held a 1.29 percent stake, according to the company's June 2026 shareholding pattern.

title: Biocon block deals: True North affiliate offloads Rs 638 crore worth shares; Citi, WhiteOak, SBI MF, Kotak Mahindra AMC among buyers
